usage: Relative threshold-shape prior only; absolute SPL values are not treated as calibrated hearing levels.
aboveStandardRange: The 12.5 kHz anchor is held while population trust is tapered toward 18 kHz.
headphoneCaveat: AudioTune reduces model trust at very low and very high frequencies because ISO 226 is a population/free-field reference while AudioTune measures a headphone/ear end-to-end chain.
